description: Tableau window/table calcs → WINPROBE-validated chart-context Sigma formulas. Moving windows (WINDOW_AVG/STDEV with offsets), percent-of-total ratios, cumulative pct, and RANK_PERCENTILE must be reported in result.workbookPatterns (chart/grouped-element context only) and must NEVER land in DM columns/metrics (window functions silently error there — noErrorColumns is the hard gate). Untranslatable calcs (WINDOW_MEDIAN, SIZE, PREVIOUS_VALUE) are flagged loudly as unsupported patterns. One plain calc (Profit Ratio) stays a DM column as the control.
